exact_source: root source_text and every node source_text; half-open UTF8 ranges relative to root source
coverage.complete_supported: Only closed exported body subtree, not full AST, signature, types, cfg, binding or execution
coverage.exported_tree_closed: All emitted nodes including signature/type metadata non-opaque
coverage.lexical_scopes_without_unknown_: No exported scope was tainted; not a claim of true binding completeness
scopes.unknown_binding_effects: Historical flag; a scope can become uncertain after earlier uses, which retain their earlier candidates
block_items: Pre-scan only for presence of Stmt::Item; if present, mark entire block scope uncertain from entry, because names may have block-wide scope. Do not resolve item declarations. This is conservative even when there is no actual collision.
attrs: Every unsupported attribute subtree retains exact source, cfg stays not_evaluated; function/parameter attributes make function scope uncertain
candidate_null: unknown_scope, no_visible_lexical_binder, or not_a_local_use distinguished by candidate_status
ordered_children: Source-byte sorted children; node IDs reflect extraction visitation, which visits let initializer before binder
